subject: math
title: 2012 EJU Session 2 — Mathematics (Course 2)
source: Examination for Japanese University Admission for International Students, 2012 Session 2 (JASSO). Official English question paper (image-only scan, rendered to page images); answers verified against the official answer key (machine-readable Course 2 column) and independently re-derived by solving.
note: The Course 2 exam has four large questions (大問 I-IV). Large questions I and IV each contain two independent sub-questions (問1, 問2); these are stored as separate entries, giving six questions. Large questions II and III are single questions. Answer-letters follow the official scheme and reset at the start of each large question (and at the start of each sub-question within I and IV). Every box was re-solved and matched to the Course 2 column of the official answer key.

questions.subtopic: Quadratic symmetric about the origin: vertex, choosing the reflected function, intersection points, max/min on an interval

en.prompt:
**[I] Q1 — Quadratic functions.**

Let $a\neq 0$. Let $G$ be the curve which is symmetric with respect to the origin $(0,0)$ to the graph of the quadratic function
$$y=ax^2-4x-4a.\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$

(1) The coordinates of the vertex of the graph of $①$ are $\left(\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{a},\ -\dfrac{\boxed{B}}{a}-4a\right)$.

(2) Among the following choices, the quadratic function whose graph is $G$ is $\boxed{C}$.

  $⓪\ y=ax^2+4x+4a\quad ①\ y=ax^2+4x-4a\quad ②\ y=ax^2-4x+4a$
  $③\ y=-ax^2+4x+4a\quad ④\ y=-ax^2-4x+4a\quad ⑤\ y=-ax^2-4x-4a$

(3) The curve $G$ intersects the graph of $①$ at the two points $\left(\boxed{DE},\ \boxed{F}\right)$ and $\left(\boxed{G},\ \boxed{HI}\right)$.

(4) Let $a=2$. Then over the interval $\boxed{DE}\le x\le\boxed{G}$, the maximum and the minimum values of the quadratic function whose graph is $G$ are $\boxed{JK}$ and $\boxed{LM}$, respectively.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅰ] 問1 — 二次関数**

$a\neq 0$ とする。$G$ を，二次関数
$$y=ax^2-4x-4a\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$
のグラフと原点 $(0,0)$ に関して対称な曲線とする。

(1) $①$ のグラフの頂点の座標は $\left(\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{a},\ -\dfrac{\boxed{B}}{a}-4a\right)$ である。

(2) 次の選択肢のうち，グラフが $G$ となる二次関数は $\boxed{C}$ である。

  $⓪\ y=ax^2+4x+4a\quad ①\ y=ax^2+4x-4a\quad ②\ y=ax^2-4x+4a$
  $③\ y=-ax^2+4x+4a\quad ④\ y=-ax^2-4x+4a\quad ⑤\ y=-ax^2-4x-4a$

(3) 曲線 $G$ は $①$ のグラフと2点 $\left(\boxed{DE},\ \boxed{F}\right)$，$\left(\boxed{G},\ \boxed{HI}\right)$ で交わる。

(4) $a=2$ とする。このとき，区間 $\boxed{DE}\le x\le\boxed{G}$ において，グラフが $G$ となる二次関数の最大値は $\boxed{JK}$，最小値は $\boxed{LM}$ である。

answer.en: Vertex $\left(\tfrac2a,\,-\tfrac4a-4a\right)$; $G$ is choice ④ $y=-ax^2-4x+4a$; intersections $(-2,8)$ and $(2,-8)$; for $a=2$ on $-2\le x\le 2$, max $=10$, min $=-8$.  Boxes: A=2, B=4, C=4, DE=-2, F=8, G=2, HI=-8, JK=10, LM=-8.
answer.ja: 頂点 $\left(\tfrac2a,\,-\tfrac4a-4a\right)$；$G$ は選択肢④ $y=-ax^2-4x+4a$；交点 $(-2,8),(2,-8)$；$a=2$ のとき $-2\le x\le 2$ で最大 $10$，最小 $-8$。 解答：A=2, B=4, C=4, DE=-2, F=8, G=2, HI=-8, JK=10, LM=-8。

explanation.en:
(1) $y=ax^2-4x-4a=a\left(x-\tfrac2a\right)^2-\tfrac4a-4a$, so the vertex is $\left(\tfrac2a,\,-\tfrac4a-4a\right)$; thus $A=2,\ B=4$.
(2) Reflecting the graph of $①$ through the origin sends $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,-y)$: $-y=a x^2+4x-4a$, i.e. $y=-ax^2-4x+4a$, which is choice ④, so $C=4$.
(3) Solve $ax^2-4x-4a=-ax^2-4x+4a\Rightarrow 2ax^2=8a\Rightarrow x^2=4\Rightarrow x=\pm2$. At $x=-2$, $y=8$; at $x=2$, $y=-8$. So the points are $(-2,8)$ and $(2,-8)$.
(4) With $a=2$, $G:\ y=-2x^2-4x+8$, a downward parabola with vertex at $x=-1$. On $[-2,2]$: max at $x=-1$ gives $-2-(-4)+8\cdots=10$, and the minimum at $x=2$ gives $-8$.
explanation.ja:
(1) $y=a\left(x-\tfrac2a\right)^2-\tfrac4a-4a$ より頂点 $\left(\tfrac2a,\,-\tfrac4a-4a\right)$，よって $A=2,\ B=4$。
(2) 原点対称は $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,-y)$。$-y=ax^2+4x-4a$ すなわち $y=-ax^2-4x+4a$（選択肢④），$C=4$。
(3) $ax^2-4x-4a=-ax^2-4x+4a\Rightarrow x^2=4\Rightarrow x=\pm2$。$(-2,8),(2,-8)$。
(4) $a=2$ で $G:\ y=-2x^2-4x+8$（上に凸，頂点 $x=-1$）。$[-2,2]$ で $x=-1$ のとき最大 $10$，$x=2$ のとき最小 $-8$。

questions.subtopic: Equation with an absolute value and a parameter: case split, an irrational case, and an integer-solution case

en.prompt:
**[I] Q2 — Absolute-value equation.** Consider the following equation in $x$, where $a$ is a constant:
$$|ax-11|=4x-10.\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$

(1) Equation $①$ can be rewritten without the absolute-value symbol as
  when $ax\ge 11$, then $\left(a-\boxed{N}\right)x=\boxed{O}$;
  when $ax<11$, then $\left(a+\boxed{P}\right)x=\boxed{QR}$.

(2) When $a=\sqrt{7}$, the solution of equation $①$ is $x=\dfrac{\boxed{S}\left(\boxed{T}-\sqrt{\boxed{U}}\right)}{\boxed{V}}$.

(3) Let $a$ be a positive integer. When equation $①$ has a positive integral solution, we have $a=\boxed{W}$, and that solution is $x=\boxed{X}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅰ] 問2 — 絶対値を含む方程式** $a$ を定数とし，$x$ についての次の方程式を考える。
$$|ax-11|=4x-10.\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$

(1) 方程式 $①$ は絶対値記号を用いずに次のように書き換えられる。
  $ax\ge 11$ のとき，$\left(a-\boxed{N}\right)x=\boxed{O}$；
  $ax<11$ のとき，$\left(a+\boxed{P}\right)x=\boxed{QR}$。

(2) $a=\sqrt{7}$ のとき，方程式 $①$ の解は $x=\dfrac{\boxed{S}\left(\boxed{T}-\sqrt{\boxed{U}}\right)}{\boxed{V}}$ である。

(3) $a$ を正の整数とする。方程式 $①$ が正の整数解をもつとき，$a=\boxed{W}$ であり，その解は $x=\boxed{X}$ である。

answer.en: Cases: $(a-4)x=1$ and $(a+4)x=21$; for $a=\sqrt7$ the valid solution is $x=\dfrac{7(4-\sqrt7)}{3}$; the only positive integer case is $a=3,\ x=3$.  Boxes: N=4, O=1, P=4, QR=21, S=7, T=4, U=7, V=3, W=3, X=3.
answer.ja: 場合分け：$(a-4)x=1$ と $(a+4)x=21$；$a=\sqrt7$ のとき有効な解は $x=\dfrac{7(4-\sqrt7)}{3}$；正の整数解をもつのは $a=3,\ x=3$ のみ。 解答：N=4, O=1, P=4, QR=21, S=7, T=4, U=7, V=3, W=3, X=3。

explanation.en:
(1) When $ax\ge11$, $|ax-11|=ax-11$, so $ax-11=4x-10\Rightarrow(a-4)x=1$; when $ax<11$, $|ax-11|=11-ax$, so $11-ax=4x-10\Rightarrow(a+4)x=21$. Thus $N=4,O=1,P=4,QR=21$.
(2) The right side $4x-10\ge0$ requires $x\ge\tfrac52$. With $a=\sqrt7$, the branch $(a-4)x=1$ gives $x=\tfrac1{\sqrt7-4}<0$ (rejected). The branch $(a+4)x=21$ gives $x=\tfrac{21}{\sqrt7+4}=\tfrac{21(4-\sqrt7)}{9}=\tfrac{7(4-\sqrt7)}{3}\approx3.16\ (\ge\tfrac52)$, and $\sqrt7\,x\approx8.36<11$ is consistent. So $x=\tfrac{7(4-\sqrt7)}{3}$, i.e. $S=7,T=4,U=7,V=3$.
(3) For a positive integer $a$: branch $(a-4)x=1$ would need $x=\tfrac1{a-4}$, only integral when $a=5,x=1$, but then $4x-10=-6<0$ (rejected). Branch $(a+4)x=21$ needs $a+4\mid21$, i.e. $a+4\in\{7,21\}$ giving $(a,x)=(3,3)$ or $(17,1)$; the case $x=1$ gives $4x-10<0$ (rejected). Only $a=3,x=3$ works (then $4x-10=2$ and $|3\cdot3-11|=2$). So $W=3,X=3$.

questions.subtopic: Triangle inscribed in a circle with a weighted vector relation: cevian point by position vectors, dot product, and segment lengths

en.prompt:
**[II] Vectors.** Suppose a triangle $ABC$ inscribed in a circle $O$ of radius $2$ satisfies
$$3\,\overrightarrow{OA}+4\,\overrightarrow{OB}+2\,\overrightarrow{OC}=\vec{0}.\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$
Let $D$ denote the point of intersection of the straight line $AO$ and the segment $BC$. We find the lengths of the segments $AD$ and $BD$.

(1) When we set $\overrightarrow{OD}=k\,\overrightarrow{OA}$ where $k$ is a real number, we have $\overrightarrow{OD}=-\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}\,k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}\,k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$. As the three points $B,C,D$ are collinear, we obtain $k=\dfrac{\boxed{EF}}{\boxed{G}}$. From this $OD=\boxed{H}$ and finally $AD=\boxed{I}$.

(2) From (1), $BD=\dfrac{\boxed{J}}{\boxed{K}}\,BC$. To find $BD$ we find $BC$. First, $BC^2=\boxed{L}-\boxed{M}\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$, where $\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$ is the inner product. Since from $①$ we have $\left|4\,\overrightarrow{OB}+2\,\overrightarrow{OC}\right|^2=\boxed{NO}$, we get $\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=\dfrac{\boxed{PQR}}{\boxed{S}}$. Hence $BC=\dfrac{\boxed{T}\sqrt{\boxed{U}}}{\boxed{V}}$ and finally $BD=\dfrac{\sqrt{\boxed{W}}}{\boxed{X}}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅱ] ベクトル** 半径 $2$ の円 $O$ に内接する三角形 $ABC$ が
$$3\,\overrightarrow{OA}+4\,\overrightarrow{OB}+2\,\overrightarrow{OC}=\vec{0}\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$
を満たすとする。直線 $AO$ と線分 $BC$ の交点を $D$ とする。線分 $AD$ と $BD$ の長さを求める。

(1) $\overrightarrow{OD}=k\,\overrightarrow{OA}$（$k$ は実数）とおくと，$\overrightarrow{OD}=-\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}\,k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}\,k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$。3点 $B,C,D$ が一直線上にあることから $k=\dfrac{\boxed{EF}}{\boxed{G}}$。これより $OD=\boxed{H}$，よって $AD=\boxed{I}$。

(2) (1) より $BD=\dfrac{\boxed{J}}{\boxed{K}}\,BC$。$BD$ を求めるため $BC$ を求める。まず $BC^2=\boxed{L}-\boxed{M}\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$（$\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$ は内積）。$①$ より $\left|4\,\overrightarrow{OB}+2\,\overrightarrow{OC}\right|^2=\boxed{NO}$ なので $\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=\dfrac{\boxed{PQR}}{\boxed{S}}$。ゆえに $BC=\dfrac{\boxed{T}\sqrt{\boxed{U}}}{\boxed{V}}$，よって $BD=\dfrac{\sqrt{\boxed{W}}}{\boxed{X}}$。

answer.en: $\overrightarrow{OD}=-\tfrac43 k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\tfrac23 k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$, $k=-\tfrac12$, $OD=1$, $AD=3$; $BD=\tfrac13 BC$, $BC^2=8-2\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$, $|4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}|^2=36$, $\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=-\tfrac{11}{4}$, $BC=\tfrac{3\sqrt6}{2}$, $BD=\tfrac{\sqrt6}{2}$.  Boxes: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=3, EF=-1, G=2, H=1, I=3, J=1, K=3, L=8, M=2, NO=36, PQR=-11, S=4, T=3, U=6, V=2, W=6, X=2.
answer.ja: $\overrightarrow{OD}=-\tfrac43 k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\tfrac23 k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$，$k=-\tfrac12$，$OD=1$，$AD=3$；$BD=\tfrac13 BC$，$BC^2=8-2\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$，$|4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}|^2=36$，$\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=-\tfrac{11}{4}$，$BC=\tfrac{3\sqrt6}{2}$，$BD=\tfrac{\sqrt6}{2}$。 解答：A=4, B=3, C=2, D=3, EF=-1, G=2, H=1, I=3, J=1, K=3, L=8, M=2, NO=36, PQR=-11, S=4, T=3, U=6, V=2, W=6, X=2。

explanation.en:
(1) From $①$, $\overrightarrow{OA}=-\tfrac13(4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC})$, so $\overrightarrow{OD}=k\,\overrightarrow{OA}=-\tfrac43 k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\tfrac23 k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$ ($A=4,B=3,C=2,D=3$). Since $D$ lies on line $BC$, the coefficients sum to $1$: $-\tfrac43 k-\tfrac23 k=1\Rightarrow-2k=1\Rightarrow k=-\tfrac12$ ($EF=-1,G=2$). Then $OD=|k|\,|OA|=\tfrac12\cdot2=1$ ($H=1$), and $\overrightarrow{AD}=(k-1)\overrightarrow{OA}$ so $AD=|k-1|\cdot2=\tfrac32\cdot2=3$ ($I=3$).
(2) With $k=-\tfrac12$, $\overrightarrow{OD}=\tfrac23\overrightarrow{OB}+\tfrac13\overrightarrow{OC}$, i.e. $D$ divides $BC$ with $BD=\tfrac13 BC$ ($J=1,K=3$). $BC^2=|\overrightarrow{OC}-\overrightarrow{OB}|^2=|OB|^2-2\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}+|OC|^2=8-2\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$ ($L=8,M=2$). From $①$, $4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}=-3\overrightarrow{OA}$, so $|4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}|^2=9\cdot4=36$ ($NO=36$). Expanding, $80+16\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=36\Rightarrow\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=-\tfrac{11}{4}$ ($PQR=-11,S=4$). Then $BC^2=8+\tfrac{11}{2}=\tfrac{27}{2}$, so $BC=\tfrac{3\sqrt6}{2}$ ($T=3,U=6,V=2$) and $BD=\tfrac13 BC=\tfrac{\sqrt6}{2}$ ($W=6,X=2$).
explanation.ja:
(1) $①$ より $\overrightarrow{OA}=-\tfrac13(4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC})$ なので $\overrightarrow{OD}=k\,\overrightarrow{OA}=-\tfrac43 k\,\overrightarrow{OB}-\tfrac23 k\,\overrightarrow{OC}$（$A=4,B=3,C=2,D=3$）。$D$ は直線 $BC$ 上なので係数の和が $1$：$-2k=1\Rightarrow k=-\tfrac12$（$EF=-1,G=2$）。$OD=|k|\cdot2=1$（$H=1$），$AD=|k-1|\cdot2=3$（$I=3$）。
(2) $k=-\tfrac12$ で $D$ は $BD=\tfrac13 BC$ を与える（$J=1,K=3$）。$BC^2=8-2\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}$（$L=8,M=2$）。$4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}=-3\overrightarrow{OA}$ より $|4\overrightarrow{OB}+2\overrightarrow{OC}|^2=36$（$NO=36$）。展開して $80+16\,\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=36\Rightarrow\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OC}=-\tfrac{11}{4}$（$PQR=-11,S=4$）。よって $BC^2=\tfrac{27}{2}$，$BC=\tfrac{3\sqrt6}{2}$（$T=3,U=6,V=2$），$BD=\tfrac{\sqrt6}{2}$（$W=6,X=2$）。

questions.subtopic: Maximizing xy^2 under a log constraint via the substitution X=log2 x, Y=log2 y: circle-and-tangent-line argument

en.prompt:
**[III] Logarithms.** Let $x$ and $y$ be positive numbers which satisfy
$$(\log_2 x)^2+(\log_2 y)^2=\log_2\dfrac{8x^2}{y^2}.\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$
We find the maximum value of $xy^2$ and the values of $x$ and $y$ at that point.

(1) The right side of $①$ can be transformed into $\log_2\dfrac{8x^2}{y^2}=\boxed{A}\log_2 x-\boxed{B}\log_2 y+\boxed{C}$. Setting $X=\log_2 x$ and $Y=\log_2 y$, $①$ becomes
$$\left(X-\boxed{D}\right)^2+\left(Y+\boxed{E}\right)^2=\boxed{F}.\qquad\cdots\cdots②$$

(2) Set $k=\log_2 xy^2$. Using $X$ and $Y$, this becomes
$$X+\boxed{G}\,Y-k=0.\qquad\cdots\cdots③$$
Graphing $②$ and $③$ in the $(X,Y)$ plane, $②$ is a circle and $③$ is a straight line. When $k$ is maximized, line $③$ is tangent to circle $②$. Hence when $k=\boxed{H}$, $xy^2$ takes the maximum value $\boxed{IJ}$, and in this case $x=\boxed{K}$ and $y=\boxed{L}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅲ] 対数** $x,y$ を正の数とし，
$$(\log_2 x)^2+(\log_2 y)^2=\log_2\dfrac{8x^2}{y^2}\qquad\cdots\cdots①$$
を満たすとする。$xy^2$ の最大値と，そのときの $x,y$ の値を求める。

(1) $①$ の右辺は $\log_2\dfrac{8x^2}{y^2}=\boxed{A}\log_2 x-\boxed{B}\log_2 y+\boxed{C}$ と変形できる。$X=\log_2 x$，$Y=\log_2 y$ とおくと，$①$ は
$$\left(X-\boxed{D}\right)^2+\left(Y+\boxed{E}\right)^2=\boxed{F}\qquad\cdots\cdots②$$
となる。

(2) $k=\log_2 xy^2$ とおくと，これは
$$X+\boxed{G}\,Y-k=0\qquad\cdots\cdots③$$
となる。$(X,Y)$ 平面で $②,③$ を描くと，$②$ は円，$③$ は直線である。$k$ が最大のとき直線 $③$ は円 $②$ に接する。よって $k=\boxed{H}$ のとき $xy^2$ は最大値 $\boxed{IJ}$ をとり，このとき $x=\boxed{K}$，$y=\boxed{L}$ である。

explanation.en:
(1) $\log_2\tfrac{8x^2}{y^2}=\log_2 8+2\log_2 x-2\log_2 y=2\log_2 x-2\log_2 y+3$ ($A=2,B=2,C=3$). With $X=\log_2 x,\,Y=\log_2 y$, $①$ is $X^2+Y^2=2X-2Y+3\Rightarrow(X-1)^2+(Y+1)^2=5$ ($D=1,E=1,F=5$): a circle centered $(1,-1)$, radius $\sqrt5$.
(2) $k=\log_2 xy^2=\log_2 x+2\log_2 y=X+2Y$, so $X+2Y-k=0$ ($G=2$). The line is tangent to the circle when its distance from $(1,-1)$ equals $\sqrt5$: $\tfrac{|1+2(-1)-k|}{\sqrt5}=\sqrt5\Rightarrow|{-1-k}|=5\Rightarrow k=4$ or $k=-6$. The maximum is $k=4$ ($H=4$), so $xy^2=2^4=16$ ($IJ=16$). The tangent (foot of perpendicular from $(1,-1)$ to $X+2Y=4$) is $(X,Y)=(2,1)$, giving $x=2^2=4$ ($K=4$) and $y=2^1=2$ ($L=2$).

questions.subtopic: Trigonometric function with a parameter fixed by a local extremum: factored derivative and max/min on a closed interval

en.prompt:
**[IV] Q1 — Differentiation.** Let $a$ be a constant. Assume the function
$$f(x)=2\sin^3 x+a\sin 2x+\tfrac{9}{2}\cos 2x-9\cos x-2ax+6$$
takes a local extremum at $x=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$. We consider the maximum and minimum values of $f(x)$ over $0\le x\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$.

(1) Since $f(x)$ takes a local extremum at $x=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$, it follows that $a=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}$. Hence the derivative is
$$f'(x)=\boxed{C}\sin x\left(\boxed{D}\cos x-1\right)\left(\sin x-\boxed{E}\right).$$

(2) From (1), over $0\le x\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, $f(x)$ takes its maximum value at $x=\boxed{F}$ and its minimum value at $x=\boxed{G}$, where $\boxed{F}$ and $\boxed{G}$ are the appropriate expressions from among $⓪$–$④$ below.

  $⓪\ 0\quad ①\ \dfrac{\pi}{6}\quad ②\ \dfrac{\pi}{4}\quad ③\ \dfrac{\pi}{3}\quad ④\ \dfrac{\pi}{2}$

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅳ] 問1 — 微分** $a$ を定数とする。関数
$$f(x)=2\sin^3 x+a\sin 2x+\tfrac{9}{2}\cos 2x-9\cos x-2ax+6$$
が $x=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ で極値をとるとする。区間 $0\le x\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ における $f(x)$ の最大値・最小値を考える。

(1) $f(x)$ が $x=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ で極値をとることから $a=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}$。よって導関数は
$$f'(x)=\boxed{C}\sin x\left(\boxed{D}\cos x-1\right)\left(\sin x-\boxed{E}\right)$$
と表せる。

(2) (1) より，$0\le x\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ において $f(x)$ は $x=\boxed{F}$ で最大，$x=\boxed{G}$ で最小となる。ここで $\boxed{F},\boxed{G}$ は下の $⓪$〜$④$ から選ぶ。

  $⓪\ 0\quad ①\ \dfrac{\pi}{6}\quad ②\ \dfrac{\pi}{4}\quad ③\ \dfrac{\pi}{3}\quad ④\ \dfrac{\pi}{2}$

answer.en: $a=\tfrac34$; $f'(x)=3\sin x(2\cos x-1)(\sin x-3)$; on $[0,\tfrac\pi2]$ the max is at $x=0$ (choice ⓪) and the min at $x=\tfrac\pi3$ (choice ③).  Boxes: A=3, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=3, F=0, G=3.
answer.ja: $a=\tfrac34$；$f'(x)=3\sin x(2\cos x-1)(\sin x-3)$；$[0,\tfrac\pi2]$ で最大は $x=0$（選択肢⓪），最小は $x=\tfrac\pi3$（選択肢③）。 解答：A=3, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=3, F=0, G=3。

explanation.en:
(1) $f'(x)=6\sin^2 x\cos x+2a\cos 2x-9\sin 2x+9\sin x-2a$. Setting $f'(\tfrac\pi3)=0$ gives $a=\tfrac34$ ($A=3,B=4$). Substituting and factoring, $f'(x)=3\sin x(2\cos x-1)(\sin x-3)$ ($C=3,D=2,E=3$).
(2) On $[0,\tfrac\pi2]$, $\sin x\ge0$ and $\sin x-3<0$, so the sign of $f'$ follows $-(2\cos x-1)$: $f'<0$ on $(0,\tfrac\pi3)$ (where $\cos x>\tfrac12$) and $f'>0$ on $(\tfrac\pi3,\tfrac\pi2)$. Thus $f$ decreases then increases, with the only interior critical point a minimum at $x=\tfrac\pi3$. Comparing endpoints, $f(0)=\tfrac32$ and $f(\tfrac\pi2)=\tfrac72-\tfrac{3\pi}{4}\approx1.14$, so the maximum is at $x=0$. Hence $F=⓪$ (max at $x=0$) and $G=③$ (min at $x=\tfrac\pi3$).
explanation.ja:
(1) $f'(\tfrac\pi3)=0$ より $a=\tfrac34$（$A=3,B=4$）。代入・因数分解して $f'(x)=3\sin x(2\cos x-1)(\sin x-3)$（$C=3,D=2,E=3$）。
(2) $[0,\tfrac\pi2]$ で $\sin x\ge0$，$\sin x-3<0$ なので $f'$ の符号は $-(2\cos x-1)$ に従う：$(0,\tfrac\pi3)$ で $f'<0$，$(\tfrac\pi3,\tfrac\pi2)$ で $f'>0$。よって $f$ は減少後増加し，$x=\tfrac\pi3$ が極小（最小）。端点比較 $f(0)=\tfrac32>f(\tfrac\pi2)=\tfrac72-\tfrac{3\pi}{4}\approx1.14$ より最大は $x=0$。ゆえに $F=⓪$，$G=③$。

questions.subtopic: Sequence of definite integrals: integration by parts recurrence, telescoping weighted sum, and limits via a squeeze

en.prompt:
**[IV] Q2 — Integral sequence.** A sequence $\{a_n\}$ is defined by
$$a_n=\int_0^{\frac14}x^n e^{-x}\,dx\qquad(n=1,2,3,\dots).$$

Then $a_1=-\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}\,e^{\frac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}}+1$. Also $a_{n+1}$ can be expressed in terms of $a_n$ as
$$a_{n+1}=-\left(\dfrac{\boxed{M}}{\boxed{N}}\right)^{n+1}e^{\frac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}}+\left(n+\boxed{O}\right)a_n\qquad(n=1,2,3,\dots).$$
Transforming into $n a_n=a_{n+1}-a_n+\left(\dfrac{\boxed{M}}{\boxed{N}}\right)^{n+1}e^{\frac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}}$, we have
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k a_k=a_{n+1}-a_1+\dfrac{\boxed{P}}{\boxed{QR}}\,e^{\frac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}}\left\{1-\left(\dfrac{\boxed{S}}{\boxed{T}}\right)^n\right\}.$$

Since, for $0\le x$, the range of $e^{-x}$ is $0<e^{-x}\le\boxed{U}$, it follows that
$$0<a_n<\int_0^{\frac14}\boxed{U}\,x^n\,dx=\dfrac{1}{\boxed{V}^{\,n+1}(n+1)}.$$
Thus, since $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=\boxed{W}$, we obtain $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n k a_k=\dfrac{\boxed{X}}{\boxed{Y}}\,e^{\frac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}}-1.$
